youtube.title: Why Birds Don't Get Shocked On Power Lines ⚡ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Current flows only where there is a difference in voltage. A bird with both feet on one line sits at the same voltage, so almost no current passes through it. Large birds that touch two lines, or a line and a grounded pole, can be electrocuted, which is why utilities fit bird guards.
